messages:
peter-fin: Alert: Card decline on INV-14220 for 'Orion Healthtech' — gateway returned 'rpc_decline' (gw_3c2f). Amount $9,450. Customer says treasury attempted via their TMS.

julia-cs: Any last4 or token id?

peter-fin: last4 8888, token tok_v8g3. No 3DS.

billing-bot: Auto-retry policy: 2 retries over 24h. Next retry scheduled in 3h (1935556655).

trent-sales: I called their AP: they can push a virtual card (single-use) or wire. Prefer v-card to avoid manual reconciliation. They asked if we can accept a tokenized PAN.

ops-bot: Note: virtual card token accepted. If token provided, ops will attempt immediate capture and pause auto-retries. If capture succeeds, flag txn for 48h reconciliation.

dina-aml: Quick KYC check on Orion (MID OR-909): onboarding complete, no sanctions. Approve one-time v-card acceptance. Recommend 48h hold on settlement.

julia-cs: I'll send secure request to treasury for token. Also offering wire instructions as fallback since amount >$5k.

peter-fin: If they choose wire, need finance lead approval. Paging @peter-fin for sign-off (self-approving here) — approve wire acceptance if they ask.

trent-sales: Sending secure form now. Customer replies: 'token sent' via secure form.

ops-bot: Received tokenized PAN (token_id tkn_552). Attempting capture now...

billing-bot: Capture result: success -> gw_tx a5f9. Amount captured $9,450. Status: held_for_recon.

dina-aml: Logged for AML: one-time v-card capture for OR-909; reconciliation hold 48h. No issues.

peter-fin: Mark invoice INV-14220 paid. Create recon ticket to match capture with any bank remittance if wire sent. Closing loop — if customer wires anyway, we'll refund duplicate.

julia-cs: Customer confirmed payment received. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
